<thought>To determine the number of methyl (CH₃) groups, I will first obtain the 13C NMR spectrum of the sample using the carbon_nmr_spectra tool. Then I will retrieve the typical carbon chemical shift range for methyl carbons (usually ~10–30 ppm) via retrieve_carbon_shifts. By counting how many peaks in the spectrum fall within that range, I can infer the number of methyl groups.</thought>
